verdict.rationale: The docs show the dashboard can be filtered by release (bugsnag-docs-4) and offer status-based error views such as 'introduced in the last 24 hours' and 'all errors except fixed, snoozed or ignored' (bugsnag-docs-3, bugsnag-docs-28). Correlated events can also be pivoted on user, device, session or trace (bugsnag-docs-20), but none of this amounts to a real query language. Missing for 10: cross-project search, filtering by tag, environment or custom metadata properties, any documented query syntax, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search capabilities.
